stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract
stories.description: Define the canonical audit log schema including timestamp, actor, action_type, payload_hash, previous_hash, outcome, and correlation_id. Enforce append-only behavior at the data model level (no updates/deletes) and ensure compatibility with MongoDB insert-only patterns used in debug_logger.

stories.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Implement backend logic to capture and persist all system actions and tool calls as immutable audit records. Include hash chaining (previous_hash → current_hash) for tamper detection, enforce write-once semantics, and automatically generate timestamps and correlation IDs.

stories.title: Tool Router and Domain Service Audit Integration
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and key domain services (safety, provider search, clinical trials) ensuring all tool invocations, safety triggers, and external API calls emit audit events with consistent correlation_id propagation across the request lifecycle.

stories.title: Audit Log Access Interface (Internal Read-Only API)
stories.description: Provide an internal read-only query interface for retrieving audit logs by correlation_id, time range, or action_type. Ensure strict read-only enforcement and support debugging and compliance workflows without exposing mutation capabilities.
stories.evidence: GAP: No explicit audit log query interface exists; required for operational visibility

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite with Tamper Detection Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating append-only enforcement, correct event capture across tool flows, hash chain integrity (detecting tampering or missing links), and ensuring no update/delete operations occur on audit records.
